content.comment_body: Hello, the datasheet indicates there are 8 digital inputs. However, when I select the module in the [product_name] programming software, only 6 digital inputs are shown as available. I am selecting the [article_no] standard module, which I believe matches the hardware described. Is this correct?

The [product_name] you have with an order number ending in [article_no] is not a standard [article_no]; it's actually a [product_name] version [version_no]. For this device, you'll need [product_name] [version_no] or newer in order to communicate with it.
Hi, please see the attached image which shows the maximum number of I/Os for [product_name]. Hope this helps.

These responses do not address the user's specific issue. The problem was simply choosing the incorrect base module.
